description: This file contains utility functions for handling URL parameters, permalink generation, URL parsing, and external URL detection within the Superset frontend project.

methods.name: getUrlParam
methods.description: Retrieves and decodes URL parameters based on specified type (string, number, boolean, object, rison).

methods.name: getUrlParams
methods.description: Constructs URLSearchParams object excluding specified parameters.

methods.name: getUrlParamEntries
methods.description: Converts URLSearchParams to an array of key-value string pairs.

methods.name: getChartUrlParams
methods.description: Generates URL parameters for charts, including active filters and exclusions.

methods.name: getDashboardUrlParams
methods.description: Generates URL parameters for dashboards, including active filters and exclusions.

methods.name: getPermalink
methods.description: Creates a permalink by posting data to the server and retrieving a key and URL.

methods.name: resolvePermalinkUrl
methods.description: Resolves a permalink URL, using a custom callback if in embedded mode.

methods.name: getChartPermalink
methods.description: Generates a permalink for a chart, resolving embedded URLs if applicable.

methods.name: getDashboardPermalink
methods.description: Generates a permalink for a dashboard, including optional chart states.

methods.name: isUrlExternal
methods.description: Checks if a URL is external based on its pattern.

methods.name: parseUrl
methods.description: Parses a URL and adds '//' prefix if external and protocol is missing.

methods.name: toQueryString
methods.description: Converts an object of parameters into a URL query string.
